'''Q Who?''' is the 41st virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on January 17, 2020 and consists of 18 cards. This set was part of the ''The Next Generation Block'' which consisted of cards from [[The Next Generation]], [[The Next Generation: Supplemental]], [[Engage]], [[The Sky's the Limit]], [[Coming of Age (expansion)|Coming of Age]], and [[Q Who? (expansion)|Q Who?]] virtual expansions.
